# CREAX.digital

CREAX.digital is an AI-native digital agency operating across three connected practices.

## Core services

- AI Content Production: AI images, AI video, brand design and campaign creative.
- Web & Mini Apps: marketing websites, web applications and Telegram Mini Apps.
- B2B Systems: custom dashboards, CRM systems, integrations and AI agent automation.

## Official language editions

- [Русский](https://creax.digital/ru/): AI-контент, сайты, miniapp, CRM, дашборды и AI-автоматизация.
- [English](https://creax.digital/en/): AI content, websites, web apps, Telegram Mini Apps, CRM and automation.
- [简体中文](https://creax.digital/zh-hans/): AIGC内容、网站与小程序、CRM、数据看板和AI自动化。
